name: Fly.io Sprites
description: Run each Orca workspace in its own Sprite, a persistent Linux VM from Fly.io. Adds Sprites under Run on > Per-Workspace Environment.

cover.alt: Sprites for Orca, with the Fly.io logo, beside an illustration of the Fly.io balloon in swim goggles swimming underwater with fish

screenshots.alt: Orca's Create worktree dialog with Run on open at Per-Workspace Environment, showing Sprites as the recipe
screenshots.caption: Pick Sprites under Run on

screenshots.alt: Provisioning VM: the recipe log shows a new Sprite being created, Orca being installed and the repository being cloned
screenshots.caption: The recipe builds a new Sprite

screenshots.alt: Claude Code in the workspace writes GREETING.md, which reads Hello from orca-demo-sprites-1f3f5676adb1 (Linux 6.1.182-s2)
screenshots.caption: Claude Code runs inside the Sprite
